title: Great Tour
text: The tour met our expectations 100%. Everything worked as described  when we booked this tour through Getyourguide. On time with a very good guide (an Italian but who clearly is in love with Spain!). The special guide for the Mosque was also good and helpful. It was my third time in Cordoba (first time for my Chinese friends) and again I felt charmed. A great daytour from Sevilla in all respects.
author: Lyon
